annotation.title_clean: 10 CFR Part 2—Agency Rules of Practice and Procedure
annotation.title_en: 10 CFR Part 2—Agency Rules of Practice and Procedure (U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Title 10 CFR Part 2 of the US Code of Federal Regulations sets the NRC's rules of practice and procedure for adjudicatory proceedings under the Atomic Energy Act: licence applications, hearings, intervention, orders, civil penalties and rulemaking. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Governs NRC licensing, enforcement, civil penalty and rulemaking proceedings.
Sets procedures for application docketing, notices of hearing and notices of proposed action.
Allows enforcement orders, demands for information and civil penalties up to $372,240 per violation.
Subpart C sets general hearing rules: petitions to intervene, electronic filing, presiding officer powers.
Includes special procedures for early site suitability review and limited work authorizations.
